messages:
Nicole (Acme Integrations): Hey @Emily, quick sync — our integrator partner AcmeCloud wants a joint GovCloud POC for a public-sector customer. They need details on licensing, SSO/SAML, egress, and whether we can support FIPS/KMS. Can we run Dedicated in the GovCloud region? Also asked for a ballpark monthly cost for a 4-GPU reserved pool.
Emily (AE): Thanks. looping in @Sam and @Raj. Can you paste partner's checklist? Any timeline? :calendar:
Nicole (Acme Integrations): They need a demo next Wed, but flexible. Here's the checklist: https://acme.example.com/poc-checklist (partner doc). Security questionnaire attached offline.
Sam (Solutions Eng): Ok. quick notes: Dedicated in GovCloud is possible with Private control plane + Gov infra. For 4x A100-equivalent GPUs -> ~reserved capacity quote depends on commit. For POC estimate: 4 GPUs continuous ~ $40k/mo retail; with 3mo trial and partner discount maybe 40-60% off. I'll pull a formal quote from finance.
Sam (Solutions Eng): From technical side, we need network peering + egress rules. Sample minimal egress NAT rule:
```
resource "aws_route" "egress" {
  route_table_id = "rtb-xxxx"
  destination_cidr_block = "0.0.0.0/0"
  nat_gateway_id = "nat-xxxx"
}
```
Sam (Solutions Eng): Also need SAML metadata from partner and IdP endpoints. We support SP-initiated SSO and can pre-configure a test client.
Raj (Security): Security: confirmed we can provide customer-managed KMS keys in Private. For FIPS: our runtime supports FIPS-compatible crypto in Private Gov builds; will need an approvals ticket and a short compliance checklist. Please send the security questionnaire; highlight these fields: encryption at rest, key rotation, HSM/KMS integration, network isolation, audit logs (retention), and access controls.
Ana (Legal): Legal: for Gov/nonstandard procurements we may need a short PSA for the POC. If partner requires a data processing addendum, upload the template and we'll review. Also if they want marketplace transacting we need the partner agreement and procuring entity details.
Marc (Infra): Infra: provisioning time for a small dedicated pool in Gov region ~ 2 business days after approvals. We'll need requested GPU type, expected max qps, and KV cache sizing. Also confirm whether they want private control-plane (VPC peering) vs full on-prem connector.
Nicole (Acme Integrations): Partner also asked about model variants and quantization — they prefer open weights but we can run both open and Redwood-verified variants. @Sam any perf delta to call out?
Sam (Solutions Eng): Quantized int8 ~ 2-3x throughput improvement, slight quality regression depending on model. Recommend running evals on customer's prompt set during POC. I can spin up a benchmark job and share results.
Emily (AE): Action items:
- Nicole: collect partner SAML metadata + security questionnaire (due EOD today)
- Sam: draft perf runbook + provisional pricing estimate (tomorrow)
- Raj: flag any nonstandard security approvals and estimate timeline (tomorrow)
- Marc: prep provisioning checklist and minimal infra runbook (today)
- Ana: note contracting triggers and what the partner needs to provide (today)
Nicole (Acme Integrations): Got it. I'll pull the questionnaire and SAML meta now.
deploy-bot: Provisioning request created: req-5248 for GovCloud dedicated pool (pending infra approval).
Emily (AE): Thanks all. Nicole — can you schedule a 30-min partner sync for Monday AM? I'll send calendar invite.
Nicole (Acme Integrations): Scheduled Monday 9am PT. Invite sent to Acme Cloud and their security lead. See you then. :thumbsup:
Raj (Security): I'll prep answers for the questionnaire and list of required controls. Also will add a short note about audit log retention options.
Sam (Solutions Eng): I'll attach a short perf test plan in #eng-ml after benchmarking. :rocket:
Emily (AE): Perfect — aiming to have a POC statement-of-work and a draft quote by Wednesday EOD.
Nicole (Acme Integrations): Great — closing loop here. Thanks everyone! :white_check_mark:
